messages:
jess: quick q — for the automatic switchover UI we're designing: do we expose separate knobs for latency vs error-rate triggers, or a single 'risk' slider that maps to a preset policy?
ryan: i'm leaning separate. ops teams often treat p95 latency and error spikes very differently. one is transient, one is systemic.
priya: separate makes sense, but we should hide advanced combos behind 'expert mode' so product teams don't shoot themselves in the foot. :sweat_smile:
ajess: good call. what about defaults? i was thinking default p95 threshold = 500ms, error_rate = 1% for hosted tiers. open to pushback.
alex: 500ms p95 seems reasonable for text-gen short prompts, but for embeddings customers we should default higher. maybe per-route presets?
ryan: agree on per-route presets. also we need to document how classifiers map errors -> triggers. e.g. 5xx vs model-internal-err vs kv-cache-miss.
jess: exactly — that's the tricky bit. UX needs to show what each trigger actually counts. otherwise people will wonder why they didn't failover.
priya: can we show a little preview: `estimated_switched_pct` if this rule were live (based on last 24h telemetry)? simple sim in the console.
alex: love that. rough sim: run sampler against 24h events and show: matched_events / total -> est switch rate. should be cheap.
ryan: +1 but be careful with retention. we only keep detailed event logs for 7d on hosted default. we might need windowed sampling to avoid heavy queries.
ops-bot: alert: heavy query pattern detected for telemetry-preview. recommend sampling the last 72h at 5% by default.
jess: good note. what's our recommended audit_sample_pct for rollouts? need both replayability and cost controls.
priya: start with audit_sample_pct=10% for canary, 1% for auto-fallback, with an option to increase. tie a cost-estimate badge in the UI.
ryan: if we do 10% for canary we can usually reconstruct ~90% of short incidents via replay. add a verb: 'capture full request body' toggle — default off for privacy.
ajess: privacy toggle is required for private deployments. add a tooltip: "captures sanitized request + token counts".
alex: UX question: when an automatic switchover happens, do we show an inline timeline in the rollout page that links to the auditable events? or a separate 'incident playback' tab?
priya: inline timeline. operator wants immediate context next to the rollout config. the playback tab can be for deep forensic.
ryan: we should also expose an API endpoint for programmatic playback: `/api/v1/rollouts/{id}/playback?sample_pct=...`. ops teams will script investigations.
ops-bot: note: ensure the playback API requires an operator role and logs access to audit log.
sam: small nit — how do we handle oscillations? if a policy flips back and forth we'll spam operators. need hysteresis like min_switch_interval and cool_down_ms.
jess: yes hysteresis. propose `min_switch_interval = 5m` and `cool_down_ms = 60000` default. can be tuned per-deployment.
ryan: add an exponential backoff on subsequent auto-swaps in 30m, 1h, 4h increments. document in rollout runbook template.
priya: UX for overrides: an operator override should be recorded with reason and optional rollback ETA. require short reason text.
ajess: agree. store operator_id, reason, expiry_ts. show in timeline.
alex: last thing — error classifier authoring. can we let users supply a small boolean expression builder (eg status==500 OR contains(msg, "OOM")) and show example matches from sample data?
ryan: yes the expression builder + live match preview will reduce confusion. default rule templates for common cases.
ops-bot: reminder: expressions must be sandboxed. no arbitrary regex-heavy jobs unauthenticated.
jess: wrapping up: i'll sketch a console mock with: two sliders (latency / error), advanced combo panel, preview sim, audit sampling badge, hysteresis controls, operator-override flow, expression builder. i'll post prototype tomorrow morning.
priya: thanks! i'll feed this into the runbook + docs checklist.
ryan: i'll add the playback API stub to the spec and link the telemetry retention constraints.
ops-bot: scheduled: prototype review meeting tomorrow 10:30am PT.
sam: added a quick todo: test sample-sim performance with 72h @5% on staging telemetry db.
jess: perfect. thanks team :rocket:
